verdict.rationale: Fathom generates AI summaries, action items, coaching scorecards, and Deal View insights directly from meeting data, and surfaces conversational assistant features for querying meeting content. Evidence is mostly marketing/pricing copy rather than in-depth product walkthroughs of the insight UI itself. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of insight quality, and detailed documentation of the in-app AI assistant/insight UX beyond feature bullet points.
